title: 'enabled GCP rotation' → flag notify-only; require a Pub/Sub-subscribed rotation fn

input.situation: I enabled rotation on our GCP Secret Manager secret. So it rotates automatically now, right?

success_criterion: Must flag GCP rotation as NOTIFY-ONLY (a false-green) and require a Cloud Function subscribed to the Pub/Sub topic. FAILS 'enabled = it rotates'.
